hypothesis: Landing variants led by push, pull and anxiety forces will differ in trial-signup rate.
metric: trial signups per landing visit, by variant
note: Queued behind E-O8-1. No variant copy exists. min_sample and stop_date stay unset until a baseline rate exists.

hypothesis: Pillar 1 (one link, brief to deposit) as hero drives more trial signups than Pillar 2.
note: Same variants as E-O8-1 (home-a vs home-b). Merged into E-O8-1; hero Pillar 1 vs Pillar 2 is read from that test.

hypothesis: The 3-proposal free cap or the 14-day Pro trial, not price alone, drives trial signups from the pricing page.
note: Not startable: decision 4 open and the hypothesis mixes cap, trial and price. Rewrite as one variable per arm before any min_sample is set.

hypothesis: If the beta and interview gates pass, launch week produces more than half of all trial starts in the 14 days after launch.
metric: share of trial_started by utm_source, launch week vs following 7 days
min_sample: not set. A share of a handful of trials is noise; state a minimum trial count before reading it
stop_date: launch date + 14 days (Dec 1 if Nov 17, Dec 22 if Dec 8)
note: Conditional on beta and interview gates on Nov 13. If gates fail, record as not run.

hypothesis: Owner-led 90/10 community participation produces trials with zero mod removals.
metric: trial_started with utm_medium=community; mod removals or bans
note: G04 community rules not verified. Record post count with any zero-removal result.

hypothesis: A 14-day trial email sequence raises activation (proposal_sent within 7 days of sign_up).
metric: activation rate across closed 7-day cohorts, before vs after the sequence is live
note: Before/after design, confounded. Needs a before-cohort of real size and email provider decision.

hypothesis: Personal notes from the owner to their contacts get more trials per message than any public channel.
metric: trials per note sent and reply rate (utm_source=warm-network)
min_sample: not set. Number of notes is the owner's to state
note: Window ends 2026-12-02. Owner states number of notes. Hand-sent only.

hypothesis: Trials from the closed beta and first public launch convert to at least 5 paid Pro subscriptions, $95 MRR, in Dec 3 - Jan 1.
metric: subscription_started count and MRR on 2027-01-01; trial-to-paid over trials whose 14 days ended
note: Revenue is 0, payments not live. Report open trials as pending. Stop 2027-01-01.

hypothesis: Median beachhead freelancer sends more than 3 proposals a month.
metric: median self-reported proposals per month across G33 interviews
note: Duplicate of E-O20-2. Retired; do not count twice.

hypothesis: Closed beta of 5-10 warm-network users can each send one real proposal before launch.
metric: count of beta users with proposal_sent before go/no-go
note: Duplicate of E-O20-1. Retired; do not count twice.

hypothesis: A closed beta of 5-10 warm-network users yields at least 5 non-owner users who each send one real proposal by Fri 2026-11-13.
metric: count of beta users with proposal_sent (utm_campaign=2026-11-beta)
min_sample: 5 non-owner users with proposal_sent (from the hypothesis)
note: Due 2026-11-13. Blockers: working app and tracking. A miss is a recorded loser with the blocker named.

hypothesis: The beachhead sends more than 3 proposals a month, so the Free cap of 3 leaves room for Pro.
metric: median proposals per month across interviewees (G41); later plan_limit_reached share of active free users
note: Due verdict 2026-11-13. No interview notes yet. Label data self-reported.

hypothesis: Variant A (one-link flow) gets more trial signups than variant B (price options).
min_sample: not set. Needs a baseline rate that does not exist yet; set it after the first 7 days of traffic. A traffic split of two small cohorts will very likely be underpowered; if so, report directional only.
stop_date: not set. Tie to launch: 14 days after the page goes live
note: First in the landing-test queue. Order: E-O8-1, then E-G09-1 (on the winner), then E-JTBD-1 only if traffic allows. No sample exists, so no read. If underpowered, report directional only.

hypothesis: Buyers understand 'proposal app for freelancers' better than 'brief-to-proposal app'.
metric: share of interviewees who correctly describe the product from the frame alone
min_sample: same 10-15 interviews as G33; owner to set the threshold before the first interview
note: Drop the search-volume part of the metric (unmeasurable, no keyword tool). Owner sets the understanding threshold before interview 1.

hypothesis: Solo freelancers rank 'client stalls between yes and deposit' as a top-3 pain.
min_sample: first 10 interviews; gate is 3 or more describe the gap as current pain (plan GN gate / G41)
note: Due 2026-11-13. Waiting on owner interview notes (gate: 3 or more of the first 10).

hypothesis: On the winning home variant, a real product visual (client-link screenshot or clip) above the fold raises sign-up per visitor.
metric: sign_up per unique visitor; cta_click rate
min_sample: not set. Needs the baseline sign_up rate from E-O8-1 first
stop_date: 14 days after it starts, and only after E-O8-1 has a winner
note: Missing min_sample, stop_date and verdict field. Runs on the E-O8-1 winner only. Avoid overlapping with E-G14-1 on the same page.

hypothesis: Showing trial-end terms and the card statement on the signup screen raises pro sign_up to trial_started.
min_sample: not set. Needs real sign_up count with plan=pro and payments live
stop_date: not set. Tie to payments go-live
note: Blocked on payments (product.json accounts.payments is null) and on decision 4 (what Pro adds). Missing min_sample, stop_date and verdict field.

hypothesis: A timed demo video on the landing page raises the trial-signup rate versus the same page without it
metric: trial signup rate per visitor; video play rate; watch-through to 0:60
note: Overlaps landing-page tests. Queue after E-G09-1 so one landing change runs at a time. Hypothesis names a 0:60 watch-through, so the video must exist first. Missing min_sample, stop_date and verdict field.
